text:
Zoe (Marketing): quick ask for launch writeups — we need a focused rerun that stresses tail latency + multilingual coverage. goal: slice-level p50/p90/p99 latencies, token-based cost, and failure rates. sample size: 10k total, stratified by token buckets and language. variants: float32 and q4_0_v2. reproducible seed required. can you take this on? ETA Thu EOD?

Jordan (Runtime): ok. need the exact sample selector (sql or list) + model artifact names. also: should we separate warm vs cold requests in the run, and what counts as warm?

Zoe (Marketing): attaching selector snippet below. prefer production routing proportions. include both warm (3 warmup tokens) and cold. use seed=42. models: rwd-7b-v1 and rwd-7b-q4_0_v2. we want raw traces + aggregated CSVs.

Amy (Eng): note: >1024 tokens hits a different kernel path and can blow up tail. suggest capping super-long sequences at 4096 for queueing sanity. also include prompt-length CDF in output so marketing can justify bucket cutoffs. recommend baseline concurrency/batch variants: concurrency=4/8/16 and batch=16/32.

Zoe (Marketing): will accept cap at 4096. include CDF. run the three concurrency variants.

Sam (Ops): scheduling a low-priority run on staging 03:00 UTC tomorrow. example run command i'll execute: 

```
./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-v1 --quant=fp32 --samples=10000 \
  --buckets "tok:<32,32-256,256-1024,>1024" --langs "en,es,zh,ar,other" \
  --warmup_tokens=3 --concurrency=8 --batch=32 --seed=42 \
  --tag warm_header=X-Path:prefetch=warm

./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-q4_0_v2 --quant=q4_0 --samples=10000 ...
```
I'll post job id when queued. :thumbsup:

runbot: Job queued -> job-20260304-015. estimated runtime ~5.5h. logs: https://ci/internal/job-20260304-015/logs

Jordan (Runtime): quick implementation detail: we'll tag requests with header X-Path:prefetch=warm for warm samples. for cold, header omitted. also we will output per-request fields: request_id, seed, lang, token_count, warm_flag, latency_ms, token_cost, error_code. good?

Zoe (Marketing): perfect. also dropping a tiny corpus of problematic examples to /mnt/marketing/edgecases_small.tar.gz (long zh threads, bidi arabic snippets, mixed-code examples).

Sam (Ops): job job-20260304-015 completed. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4784001234/. short notes: both variants run, 10k samples each, concurrency sweeps 4/8/16. initial aggregate: q4_0_v2 p99 improved by ~8% on short tokens (<32) but regressed ~12% on >1024; overall failure rate 0.27% (zh long sequences concentrated). attached per-slice CSVs and full trace tar. preparing formal report with plots in ~1h.

Amy (Eng): flagged a kernel fallback in logs around run 2. we serialized the stacktrace to s3 path above. likely triggered by a rare tokenization edgecase in zh. recommend adding a tiny warmup of 8 tokens for zh in next run to see impact.

Zoe (Marketing): thanks team — this is exactly what we need for launch claims & webinar slides. we'll review report and follow up if we want a focused zh-resilience rerun. :raised_hands:
